name: MKT_RM_RULE_HEADERS
description: This table stores the response rule header information used for response processing.

columns.name: RULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Rule Header Id. Primary key of the rule header table.

columns.name: RULESET_ID
columns.description: Reference to the rule set to be which this rule belongs.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Action Type. Holds the action which will be executed if the rule is satisfied.

columns.name: LIST_ID
columns.description: List Id. Identifier of the list for the action 'Add to List'.

columns.name: STAGE_ID
columns.description: Stage Id.  Identifier of the stage for the action 'Add to Campaign Stage'

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTION_LAUNCH_LAG
columns.description: Action Launch Lag. Specfies the lag or time to wait before executing the action.

columns.name: ACTION_LAUNCH_LAG_UNIT
columns.description: Action Launch Lag Unit. The time unit for action launch lag (e.g Hours, Days, Weeks, Months, Years)

columns.name: GROUPING_EXPRESSION
columns.description: Grouping Expression. The grouping expression used in advanced rule mode (e.g 1 AND (2 OR 3))
